title: Use
raw_text:
9/29/26, 10:16 AM
Use

After you have released items, you have to submit them.

Prerequisites

You must have authorization to submit receivables to collection agencies (authorization object F_KKINK). In Customizing for
Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable, under: |)}*Business Transactions » Submit to Collection Agency » Define Submission
Status 3, you have defined the status for which an item may be submitted. In the standard system, you can submit items that have
one of the following submission statuses:

e Receivable Released for Submission (01)

e Receivable Recalled (09)

e Receivable Partially Cleared (13)

e Receivable Released and Partially Not Collectable (14)

e Receivable Recalled and Partially Not Collectable (16)

Key Features

For the submission, the system carries out the following steps:

1. Selects released items

eo Holds the date of submission, the submission status 02 (Receivable Submitted), and the submitted amount, if this
is different to the amount of the open item, in the collection item

o Enters a payment lock, dunning lock, and, if it exists, the alternative payer in the document

o Generates a list for each collection agency containing all receivables that are being submitted. The system can
process collection items for different collection agencies in one submission run and creates a list when doing so. You
can process the list with the standard functions for lists. From the list, you can branch to the master data of the

business partner, the business partner’s contract account, the master data of the collection agency, and the posted
document.

2. Transfer of the Submission Data
o Submitting Using Files

In the standard system, the system can create a separate file containing the receivables being submitted for each
collection agency in a submission run. You can forward the file directly to the collection agency. For your own
information purposes, you can store the file on an application server.

o Submission via Enterprise Service or API

If you use this option, the data on submission is sent using enterprise service Request Commissioned Outstanding
Collections as Bulk or API Collection Agency - Submit Bulk Request. A service call relates to only one collection

agency. The message of a service can contain receivables that are submitted to the given collection agency for
multiple business partners. However, for each service call, there is a maximum number allowed for business
partners. Therefore, several service calls can sometimes be necessary during a submission run for a collection
agency.
